reason: 该插件的主要用途是将 aimux 的模型接入层映射为 DeepSeek Harness 的模型路由，在 DSH 内按模型 route 调度多个外部 LLM 服务；该结论来自仓库描述、README 中的安装与配置说明（含供应商路由、环境变量/凭据、流式聊天与工具调用）以及包清单中对 @arcships/aimux 与 dsh 相关依赖的声明。

summaries.zh: 该插件是 DeepSeek Harness 的模型适配器，将 aimux 的多厂商模型能力映射为 DSH 模型路由，用于在 DSH 内配置并调用外部 LLM 服务。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness adapter plugin that maps aimux model providers to DSH model routes so users can configure and use external LLM providers from within DSH.

capabilities: Read and pass provider credentials from dsh credential store or environment variables
Forward chat requests to external LLM provider endpoints through aimux
Support per-route provider configuration including baseUrl and headers
Provide configurable model route mapping from dsh route IDs to aimux providers
Enable streaming responses and pass-through of JSON tool-call payloads
